title: Self-service DR drill builder for Private (VPC) deployments
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a self-service, auditable DR drill builder for Private (VPC) deployments so platform engineers and customers can compose and run deterministic failover rehearsals without one-off runbooks. The builder should stitch Terraform/IaC preflight checks, upgrade fencing, synthetic traffic replay, KV/stateful fencing, and post-run artifacts (audit logs, dashboards, and rollback playbooks).

Scope:
- A UI + API in Console to configure a drill template (regions, target stacks, sequencing, preflight validators).
- Terraform modules and automated plan/apply hooks that can run in a dry-run mode and a controlled execution mode.
- Preflight checks: drift detection, network partition sim, canary kube node cordon, storage failover preview, database read-only promotion simulation.
- Execution orchestration: scheduled windows, step gating (manual approval or auto-pass), timeouts, backoff rules, and automatic rollback on failed health gates.
- Observable outputs: step-level metrics, logs, generated runbook artifact, and an exportable audit trail suitable for compliance reviews.
- Integrations: Console run display, Slack notifications to on-call, GitHub PR creation for terraform changes, optional SRE runbook attachment.

Acceptance criteria:
- Engineers can create a reusable drill template from Console and run a dry-run that executes all preflight validators without changing production state.
- A controlled execution can complete a staged region cutover for a Private stack (control plane + data-plane fencing) with automatic KV cache dump and rehydrate steps validated by health checks.
- Post-run artifacts (plan diffs, terraform state snapshots, failure/success timeline) are stored and accessible from the ticket and Console.
- Security review completed for secrets handling and KMS/HSM interactions during drills.

Non-goals: Live application failovers for Hosted (public) stacks or replacing existing runbooks for Managed Enterprise customers until v1 is validated.
